item.title: The Citadel chooses four candidates to serve as 21st president
item.description: The Citadel announced four finalists for president as Gen. Glenn Walters prepares to retire June 30 after eight years leading the military college. The post The Citadel chooses four candidates to serve as 21st president appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: UNDER CONSTRUCTION: Woodruff High School coming together
item.description: Under Construction highlights commercial projects across Upstate and Lowcountry South Carolina, including schools, offices, churches and mixed-use developments. The post UNDER CONSTRUCTION: Woodruff High School coming together appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: AnMed Foundation gets $50K for Upstate Pre-Med Bootcamp
item.description: AnMed Foundation received a $50,000 Power:Ed grant to support the Upstate Pre-Med Bootcamp, expanding access for South Carolina students pursuing medical careers. The post AnMed Foundation gets $50K for Upstate Pre-Med Bootcamp appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Plutonium-244 recovery efforts begin at Savannah River Site
item.description: Savannah River National Laboratory launches Mark-18A recovery program to extract rare plutonium-244 and heavy curium at Savannah River Site. The post Plutonium-244 recovery efforts begin at Savannah River Site appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Judson Mill wins AIA Greenville 2025 Honor Award
item.description: Judson Mill earned the AIA Greenville 2025 Honor Award for adaptive reuse, recognizing its $160M redevelopment in Greenville County. The post Judson Mill wins AIA Greenville 2025 Honor Award appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Lowcountry Land Trust protects 50 acres on Johns Island
item.description: Lowcountry Land Trust secured permanent protection of 50 acres on Johns Island through a conservation easement funded by Charleston County Greenbelt. The post Lowcountry Land Trust protects 50 acres on Johns Island appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Six Nineteen of 1865 launches e-commerce nationwide

item.title: Goldrich Kest buys Summerville warehouse
